patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Friend) I found him slumped over and I couldn't wake him up. He's barely breathing — really slow. There were pills around. Please help him.
presentation.triageNote: 32-year-old male found slumped beside loose pills. He is minimally responsive, breathing six times per minute, with oxygen saturation 82%, pinpoint pupils, and blue discoloration around the lips.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 1 is appropriate because minimal responsiveness, respiratory rate 6, oxygen saturation 82%, cyanosis, and pinpoint pupils require immediate ventilatory support and antidote treatment.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has profound respiratory depression and hypoxemia with a toxidrome strongly suggesting opioid exposure.
clinical.acuityReason: Ineffective ventilation and cyanosis are immediately life-threatening; airway support precedes or accompanies antidote administration.
expectedResources: Immediate airway positioning and bag-mask ventilation
Evaluation for co-ingestion and recurrent toxicity
teachingPoints: Ventilation and oxygenation should not wait for the antidote to take effect.
Recurrent respiratory depression can occur after naloxone wears off.

possibleDiagnoses: Other cause of coma with respiratory depression
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate ventilatory support and naloxone would be followed by prolonged observation or admission based on recurrence and the exposure involved.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped limply, head lolling, eyes closed
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 32-year-old man, pale with a bluish tint, slumped limply on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped with his head lolling and eyes closed, unconscious. Expression: slack and unresponsive. Clearly visible: a limp posture and pale, bluish lips. No text, no logos.
